dedupe_keys.name: grand poitiers open data dams and flood defences datasets

description: Grand Poitiers Open Data: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Poitiers Open Data. Coverage: Grand Poitiers Open Data. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Environnement - Trame verte - Réservoirs écologiques - Grand Poitiers ; Environnement - Trame bleue - Réservoirs écologiques (lignes) - Grand ; Environnement - Trame bleue - Réservoirs écologiques (surfaces) - Gran. Formats seen: URL, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
